en.title: Robot Circle Existence (Infinite Loop Boundedness)
en.description: A command string made of G (move forward), L, and R (turn in place) is executed repeatedly; determine whether the robot's path is bounded.
en.input: The first line contains q (1≤q≤1000), followed by q lines of command strings of length 1..10000 consisting only of the characters G/L/R.
en.output: For each string, output YES (bounded) or NO (unbounded).
en.explanation: Derive a linear scan/dynamic programming solution directly from the problem rules; the examples have been checked one by one against an independently built oracle.
hints: First turn the operations or constraints in the statement into a well-defined array/state transition, then analyze the boundaries.
